title: DAYFOLD — Single-portion oat breakfast pouches, 6 deliverables

config.text:
# DAYFOLD client facts

## Range
- Brand: DAYFOLD
- Product: instant oat breakfast
- Audience: adults preparing breakfast at home or at their desks
- Dry portion per sealed pouch: 45 g
- Portions per pouch: 1
- AC45: Apple & Cinnamon
- CB45: Cocoa & Banana
- BV45: Blueberry & Vanilla
- Front tagline: ONE POUCH. ONE BREAKFAST.
- Front reading order: brand, flavour, portion
- Back reading order: ingredients and allergens, preparation, storage
- Fixed packaging wording: client-copy.en.md
- Existing identity: dayfold-wordmark.png

## Structure
- Construction: flat sachet; two separately printed faces; four-edge heat seal
- Face dimensions: 140 x 180 mm
- Side seals: 8 mm
- Top seal: 12 mm
- Bottom seal: 10 mm
- Tear line: y = 20 mm
- Left V notch vertices: (0,18), (3,20), (0,22) mm
- Right V notch vertices: (140,18), (137,20), (140,22) mm
- Copy-safe region: x = 12–128 mm; y = 30–166 mm
- Copy-safe dimensions: 116 x 136 mm
- Filled appearance: modest pillow shape with full-height flat side seals
- Shelf support: plain retaining tray
- Structural coordinate record: pouch-geometry.en.md

## Preparation
- Opening: top strip torn away from a side notch
- Food destination: bowl
- Dry amount: entire 45 g pouch
- Water: 120 ml hot water
- First stirring: after adding water
- Waiting time: 3 minutes
- Second stirring: after waiting
- Preparation illustration SKU: AC45
- Single-pouch display SKU: AC45

## Display quantities
- Shelf total: 9 pouches
- AC45 shelf quantity: 3
- CB45 shelf quantity: 3
- BV45 shelf quantity: 3
- Reduced comparison face width: 70 mm
- Reference atmosphere: practical desk breakfast

| 4 | opening-preparation | AC45 opening and preparation illustration | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 5 | shelf-display | Three-flavour shelf display | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 6 | ac45-pouch-display | AC45 single-pouch display | 6 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |

# DAYFOLD fixed pouch geometry

## Construction

- Pack type: flat, four-edge heat-sealed sachet
- Panel arrangement: two equal, separately printed face panels bonded at their perimeter
- Face width: 140 mm
- Face height before opening: 180 mm
- Artwork arrangement: two outside faces displayed side by side
- Back orientation: upright, read directly from outside
- Coordinate origin on each outside face: top-left corner
- Positive x direction: right
- Positive y direction: down
- Coordinate units: mm
- Seal and notch geometry: symmetric on both faces
- Filled appearance: modest pillow shape
- Filled thickness: illustration-dependent
- Side edges: flat, sealed, full height
- Top and bottom edges: straight heat seals
- Opening result: detached upper strip and one continuous lower pouch
- Shelf support: plain retaining tray or rail

- Diagram content: two outside faces, dimensions, seals, notches and copy-safe bounds

- Printed surface and structural guides: separate visual layers
- Structural coordinate source: geometry records above

steps.userMessage:
DAYFOLD | Single-portion oat breakfast pouches

We need a retail pouch family for adults making breakfast at home or at their desks. Each pouch contains one complete 45 g dry portion. The range is AC45 / Apple & Cinnamon, CB45 / Cocoa & Banana and BV45 / Blueberry & Vanilla. Retain the attached DAYFOLD wordmark and develop the flavour graphics and information layout around it. Print "DAYFOLD" and "ONE POUCH. ONE BREAKFAST." on every front, together with its flavour name, product code, breakfast descriptor and net weight. The front should read brand, flavour, then portion; the back should lead from ingredients and allergens to preparation and storage. Ingredient imagery, where used, should depict ingredients listed for that flavour.

The pack is a flat, four-edge heat-sealed sachet with two separately printed 140 x 180 mm faces. Side seals are 8 mm, the top seal is 12 mm and the bottom seal is 10 mm. Opposed V notches meet the intended tear line at y = 20 mm. Required copy and its immediate label backgrounds belong inside x = 12–128 mm and y = 30–166 mm on each face. Opening removes the upper strip; the whole portion then goes into a bowl with 120 ml hot water, followed by stirring and a 3-minute wait. Use AC45 throughout the separate preparation illustration and single-pouch display. Filled pouches should have a modest pillow shape, with their sealed edges and notches recognisable.

Audience: adults choosing a quick breakfast and comparing ingredients, with the brand and packaging teams using the work to approve the range's reading order and shelf distinction.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md holds the range, portion and structural facts. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the proportions, formats and stages of the six deliverables. client-copy.en.md contains the fixed front, back and preparation wording for each SKU. pouch-geometry.en.md records the face coordinates, seals, notches and copy-safe bounds. pouch-geometry.png is the constraint image for the two outside faces. dayfold-wordmark.png is the identity image for the wordmark retained across the range. breakfast-desk-reference.png is an atmosphere reference for a practical desk breakfast.

Deliverables:
1. Three finished flat artwork boards, one each for AC45, CB45 and BV45, each containing its complete upright front and back, all fixed copy and a separate dimension-guide key
2. One four-step opening and preparation illustration using AC45, with the four numbered preparation sentences and caution sentence
3. One shelf display showing nine filled pouches, three per SKU, in a plain retaining tray, with a comparison strip of the three fronts at half their original face width
4. One AC45 single-pouch display showing a filled pouch in a front three-quarter view and an upright rear-view inset

Acceptance:
- The three flat artwork boards carry their matching FRONT, BACK and COMMON BACK COPY records from client-copy.en.md in full; each front also carries its matching AC45, CB45 or BV45 product code. DAYFOLD, flavour and NET WT 45 g occupy the same positions across the three fronts.
- The three flat artwork boards show two separate 140 x 180 mm faces with 8 / 12 / 10 mm side, top and bottom seals, both V notches and the y = 20 mm tear reference. Their dimension-guide keys identify the x = 12–128 mm, y = 30–166 mm copy-safe rectangle, and all required text and its label backgrounds fit inside it.
- The flat artwork boards, shelf display and single-pouch display retain the attached DAYFOLD wordmark and repeat the same artwork for each SKU. Any pictured ingredients match that SKU's ingredient statement in client-copy.en.md.
- The preparation illustration presents four ordered actions: tearing at a notch, emptying the whole 45 g portion into a bowl, adding 120 ml hot water and stirring, then waiting 3 minutes and stirring again. Its printed steps and caution match client-copy.en.md, and AC45 remains recognisable through the opening sequence.
- The shelf display contains three AC45, three CB45 and three BV45 pouches held upright by the retaining tray. Its half-width comparison strip shows each complete front at 70 mm face width, with the flavour name and product code readable on all three.
- The single-pouch display matches the AC45 flat artwork on both visible faces; it and the shelf display retain the four sealed edges, paired notches and modest pillow-shaped filling described in pouch-geometry.en.md.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
